videos.title: Making money online basically comes down to two things...
videos.author: Ali Abdaal
videos.description:
Making money online basically comes down to two things - building something people want, and then actually selling it to them.

Most of us love the building part. It's fun, it's creative, you can use AI, whatever. But it's the selling that determines whether you're making money or just doing a hobby
